Gated and merged at 2ddbcd5. Candidate 96a7963, gated merged tree 203316ef, GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1357 tests, 0 errors, 0 failures. Branch verified as main before merge; pre-landing tree recompute moved and narrowing to *.scala/*.sbt/project returned zero files (bookkeeping only), so the gate held.

First slice of the second population landed, and the sub-shape (b) prediction held: Gold already had a real smart constructor and only needed its constructor closed, so this was the cheap one and it establishes the probe pattern B, C and D are copying.

Process note against myself: my first check of this gate reported an EMPTY GATE_EXIT and I nearly read that as a failure. The grep had raced the file write; the marker was present a moment later and the process had exited. Checking the process state and the log length distinguished 'marker not written yet' from 'run died before writing it' -- those look identical in a single grep and mean opposite things.
